reviews.title: Videos
reviews.text:
I’m really disappointed with B612 because I lost a 15-minute video due to what seems like a serious data-loss issue.

I was filming a long video and paused it without saving yet because I planned to continue/save it afterward. Then, while I was setting up a new phone, B612 asked me to connect to another device. I pressed the X to cancel the connection, and when I returned, my entire unsaved 15-minute video was gone.

For a camera app, this is a major problem. Long videos should not disappear that easily because of an unrelated pop-up or accidental screen change. B612 really needs an autosave or temporary draft system for recordings, especially longer ones. At the very least, there should be a clear warning saying that the current recording will be permanently deleted before anything causes it to disappear.

Please fix this. People use camera apps to record important moments that cannot always be recreated.

reviews.title: Problem!
reviews.text:
I’m having a problem with the Makeup tools on my iPhone 11.

B612 was working perfectly about a month ago, and I could use all the Makeup tools and Lipstick colors normally. After a recent update, many Makeup options disappeared. I deleted and reinstalled the app today, but now NONE of the Makeup tools can be applied to my photos.

When I select Lipstick or any other Makeup tool, I get this message: “You are not connected to the network. Please check your network settings and try again.”

My internet is working normally, and the other B612 features work. I also use B612 on Android, and Makeup works perfectly there.

Is anyone else having this problem on iPhone? If you know how to fix it, please help!
